records.claim_text: The guidance defines service boundaries, outputs, volumes and enabling activities, and calls for recorded assumptions when operational data are incomplete.
records.limitations: The JGA catalogue uses labelled planning effort and unresolved activity volumes. This source does not validate its hours, wages, sales or service usefulness.

records.claim_text: Service activities and cost pools should use explicit consumption drivers and reconcile without omissions or duplicate allocations.
records.limitations: Applied selectively to shared report, customer, partner and event work. No public-sector overhead percentage, salary divisor or worked-example quantity is adopted.

records.claim_text: The guidance calls for proportionate assurance, consistent unit-cost denominators and transparent uncertainty rather than artificial precision.
records.limitations: The workbook is an internal planning component, not an independently validated commercial budget or JGA statutory charging method. No confidence interval or universal contingency is inferred.
